messages.english: Quick sale names rand and links to invoices in another currency.
messages.translation: Ukuthengisa okusheshayo kubalula irandi futhi kuxhumanisa nama-invoyisi kwenye imali.

messages.english: My Records → Sold → Quick sale entry
messages.translation: Amarekhodi Ami → Okudayisiwe → Ukufaka kokuthengisa okusheshayo

messages.english: Quick sale records South African rand (ZAR). For another supported currency, open the separate sale-invoice form and choose its currency and payment status. Enter the sale there; the quick-sale draft is not transferred.
messages.translation: Ukuthengisa okusheshayo kurekhoda irandi laseNingizimu Afrika (ZAR). Ngenye imali esekelwayo, vula ifomu le-invoyisi yokuthengisa elihlukile bese ukhetha imali yalo nesimo sokukhokha. Faka ukuthengisa lapho; uhlaka lokuthengisa okusheshayo aludluliswa.

messages.english: See when monthly temperatures are incomplete or need another check.
messages.translation: Bona lapho amazinga okushisa anyanga zonke engaphelele noma edinga okunye ukuhlolwa.
Hlola ukutholakala kwamazinga okushisa anyanga zonke

messages.english: Map → Site details → Overview or Climate
messages.translation: Ibalazwe → Imininingwane yesiza → Isifinyezo noma Isimo Sezulu

messages.english: Check whether all monthly mean temperatures were supplied. Missing or unrecorded coverage holds the monthly calendar and planner climate interpretation; reload online to try again. Your saved maps, records and original estimates remain available. Complete model inputs do not confirm local crop suitability.
messages.translation: Hlola ukuthi wonke amazinga okushisa ayisilinganiso anyanga zonke anikeziwe yini. Ukutholakala okushodayo noma okungarekhodiwe kubamba ikhalenda lanyanga zonke nencazelo yesimo sezulu somhleli; layisha kabusha ku-inthanethi ukuze uzame futhi. Amabalazwe akho agciniwe, amarekhodi nezilinganiso zokuqala kuhlala kukhona. Okufakiwe kwemodeli okuphelele akuqinisekisi ukufaneleka kwezilimo zendawo.

messages.english: Choose app help separately from advice about a saved site.
messages.translation: Khetha usizo lohlelo lokusebenza ngokwehlukana neseluleko mayelana nesiza esigciniwe.

messages.english: Review your LimaBar question before sending it.
messages.translation: Buyekeza umbuzo wakho we-LimaBar ngaphambi kokuwuthumela.

messages.english: Choose the scope of your question

Choose Using the app for general help without attaching saved-site or record context. Advice about your own site needs supported country details saved to your signed-in account. Replies and attachments retire when their context changes. Manual maps and records remain available.
messages.translation: Khetha Ukusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze uthole usizo oluvamile ngaphandle kokunamathisela isiza esigciniwe noma umongo wamarekhodi. Iseluleko mayelana nesiza sakho sidinga imininingwane yezwe esekelwayo egcinwe ku-akhawunti yakho ongene kuyo. Izimpendulo nezinanyathiselwa kuyaphela lapho umongo wazo ushintsha. Amabalazwe amarekhodi owasebenzisayo ngesandla ahlala ekhona.
